property_summary: In the reference C, setL1BlockValues is a pure gatekeeper: whenever the call succeeds (caller == depositorAccount) no state is written, so c.hash() always remains its initial bytes32(0); the mutant stores _hash, so after a successful call c.hash() equals the fuzzed _hash instead of zero.
change_summary: Insert an assignment that stores _hash into the state variable hash, which P never writes.
